bio: Set in the heart of Tavistock, The Bedford Hotel offers stylish dining in a relaxed and traditional setting. The bustling bar and lounges are popular with locals and visitors alike, and provide the perfect place for a delicious Afternoon Tea. The Afternoon Tea is served in one of the many comfortable lounges within the hotel. In the summer months guests can enjoy Afternoon Tea in the secret walled garden in the grounds of The Bedford Hotel. The Afternoon Tea is a treat not to be missed. The Afternoon Tea comes complete with home baked scones served with local strawberry jam and rich clotted cream, and each aspect of the menu revolves around seasonal produce. If you're feeling extra indulgent, why not enjoy a flute of Prosecco alongside your Afternoon Tea? The Bedford Hotel are happy to cater to special dietary requirements with advance notice. The Bedford Hotel in Devon sits in the centre of Tavistock on the edge of the river Tavy and the Dartmoor National Park.
